name: Sunny Side Up diner banner on the home page (option 2)
hypothesis: Showing the 1950s diner Sunny Side Up banner (skillet, order ticket, service bell, direct shop link, OZ.1i and Mezz.1 only) under the value strip gets more home-page visitors to add a cover to their cart than the home page without it. A second design option alongside home-sunny-banner; a draft for a future slot, and control keeps whatever is in the banner slot when it starts.
